answer: Earn on two layers: the public rubric and the held-out probe. The visible grove of rules teaches what good looks like — but at close, a falcon releases the held-out question no identity ever saw, testing whether understanding was real or rubric-shaped. Answers that ace the public layer yet fail the probe reveal template-fitting, and the fleet behind them pays: grades void, emission reclaimed. Growing a pearl takes the mechanism in mind, not the shape in memory. Clone farms optimized for visible rules shatter on the hidden layer; their cost per passing answer rises above any honest agent's.
